import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();

        long bestNum = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        long bestDen = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        long bestErr = Long.MAX_VALUE;

        for (long b = 1; b <= n; ++b) {
            long base = x * b / y;
            long start = Math.max(base - 10, 0L);
            long end = base + 9;
            for (long a = start; a <= end; ++a) {
                long err = Math.abs(x * b - a * y);
                if (bestErr * b > err * bestDen) {
                    bestErr = err;
                    bestNum = a;
                    bestDen = b;
                } else if (bestErr * b == err * bestDen) {
                    if (bestDen > b || (bestDen == b && bestNum > a)) {
                        bestErr = err;
                        bestNum = a;
                        bestDen = b;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(bestNum + "/" + bestDen);
        sc.close();
    }
}
